title: Melitta style wedge pour-over brewing guide
scope: App-authored 20 g / 320 g beginner baseline for the current European Melitta plastic 1x4 ribbed two-outlet dripper and matching 1x4 wedge paper; separate US #2/#4 and Japanese single-hole variants.

recipe.name: Two-outlet 1x4 beginner baseline, 20 g / 320 g
equipment: Current European Melitta plastic 1x4 dripper with two outlets and ribs
Stable heat-safe server with room for whole batch and clearance below outlets
recipe.grind_description: Medium starting texture with visible small granules, not powder; no transferable grinder number.

expected_time_s.clock_start: First brew water touching coffee; includes bloom pouring time
expected_time_s.clock_end: No standing pool above the bed and stream has reduced to occasional drips

recipe.completion_signal: After all 320 g is added, standing water has drained and the outlet stream becomes occasional drips; remove dripper carefully.

steps.instruction: Place dripper and server securely; check both outlets are clean, the server opening is clear and coffee cannot reach the outlets.
steps.why: Check hardware restrictions and stability before adjusting grind.
steps.completion: Stable assembly with open outlets and room for the whole batch.

steps.instruction: Fold bottom and side seams of matching 1x4 wedge paper, seat it, rinse with hot water and discard rinse water.
steps.why: Seats paper and preheats equipment without counting rinse water in the recipe.
steps.completion: Paper fits without crumpling; server contains no rinse water.

steps.instruction: Add 20 g medium-ground coffee, level gently and tare the scale; do not tare again between pours.
steps.why: The scale then measures cumulative brew-water input only.
steps.completion: Level coffee bed and zeroed scale.

steps.instruction: Start timer at first water contact and gently wet all grounds with 40 g; wait until the clock reaches 30 seconds including pouring time.
steps.why: A selected 2:1 bloom allowance wets the bed before larger additions.
steps.completion: All grounds are wet and clock reads 0:30; visible foam is not required.

steps.instruction: Add 140 g gently over coffee to reach 180 g total. Pause if necessary to stay below the paper edge and rim; wait until the standing water has largely drained.
steps.why: Split additions leave headroom while maintaining a clear cumulative scale target.
steps.completion: Scale reads 180 g and standing water has largely drained.

steps.instruction: Add the remaining 140 g gently over coffee, pausing to preserve headroom, and stop at 320 g total.
steps.why: Completes the weighed input-water recipe without flooding.
steps.completion: Scale reads 320 g; no overflow or paper collapse.

steps.instruction: Wait for standing water to disappear and the stream to become occasional drips, remove the hot dripper onto a heat-safe dish, mix the server and serve.
steps.why: Observable drainage decides completion; measured input is not a promised beverage yield.
steps.completion: No standing pool remains and the server contains mixed brewed coffee.

variants.name: US one-cup plastic SKU 64007
variants.how_it_differs: Manufacturer explicitly accepts #2 or #4 wedge paper; this permission does not establish interchangeability for every regional Melitta dripper or increase dripper capacity. Top-rack dishwasher care is model-specific.

variants.name: Japanese single-hole Hasami
variants.how_it_differs: Named 1x1/1x2 ceramic models have one outlet and their own paper sizes; maker procedure blooms briefly then adds remaining water once. This guide's two-outlet recipe is not their official procedure.

variants.name: Voltage 23.5 g / 400 g pulse recipe
variants.how_it_differs: Original page uses 50 + 50 + 100 + 100 + 100 g. Its timing is internally inconsistent and its single-hole scope must not be silently extended to all Melitta models.

troubleshooting.check_first: Confirm correctly sized and seated paper, clean outlets, clear server opening, outlet clearance above brewed liquid and pours below the rim.
troubleshooting.adjustment: After setup checks, grind slightly coarser for the next brew; do not force water through or add extra water.

troubleshooting.check_first: Confirm weighed dose, complete bed wetting and pouring onto coffee rather than bare side paper.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Try slightly finer grinding next time, with other variables unchanged.

troubleshooting.symptom: Sharp, bitter or drying taste despite sound setup
troubleshooting.check_first: Confirm recipe quantities, kettle temperature and even wetting; consider the coffee's roast and inherent flavor.
troubleshooting.adjustment: For unpleasant sharpness try finer grinding; for bitter or drying taste try coarser grinding or lower temperature, changing one variable per brew. These are app-authored starting diagnostics, not certain causes.

safety: Keep server and dripper stable and hands clear of hot liquid.
Keep liquid below paper edge and dripper rim; pause pours when headroom is insufficient.
Do not allow rising brewed coffee to submerge outlets; monitor the server level.
Cool used grounds before discarding the paper; wash, rinse and dry equipment and clear both outlets.
Selected European plastic 1x4 dripper is dishwasher safe; US SKU 64007 specifies top rack. Follow separate care instructions for other models.

app_audit.finding: No standalone MELITTA enum method. The exact recipe and generic wedge profile are separate from legacy everyday methods; grinders.json has no Melitta-specific mapping.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Do not present exact-catalog presence as complete everyday-method, grinder or localization support. If adding everyday support, use wedge geometry and equipment-dependent capacity.

app_audit.finding: manual_wedge_generic correctly uses wedge_paper, separate from conical profiles, but represents no specific outlet arrangement.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Retain wedge distinction and describe actual model/paper compatibility; do not imply every Melitta dripper has one small hole.

app_audit.finding: wedge_pulse_23_5_400 stores correct 23.5/400 quantities and rounded 17.02 ratio, 91-96 C approximation, 210-240 s range, six stages and BATTLE_TESTED evidence label. Current webpage evidence does not establish repeatable validation, and timing is internally inconsistent.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Describe a published-web-recipe adaptation with medium confidence, document timing ambiguity, and avoid treating the evidence class as physical validation.

app_audit.finding: Typed plan has 40 s bloom and additions/cumulative totals 50/50, 50/100, 100/200, 100/300, 100/400. The 25,30,30,90 s source step durations are absent; final observation targets 210-240 s. Correct water arithmetic does not resolve published timing contradictions.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Keep observable drainage and label the timing interpretation as an adaptation; make clock origin and bloom interval explicit rather than claim exact source transcription.

app_audit.finding: Live wedge recipe calls intermediate pulses condition-dependent and mostly drained, then targets about 3:30-4:00. Side-paper warning attributes fines collecting near restricted outlet; all physical warning fields except that final warning are None. P1ExactGuidanceCatalog loads this resource and applies factual errata.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Use clear wet-bed and below-rim pour cues, explain side-paper bypass, add model-aware paper-fit and outlet/headroom checks, and label the adapted schedule. Avoid an unverified universal fines-through-paper outlet-clog mechanism.

app_audit.finding: Current factual errata cover Clever, cezve and Cup-One but contain no Melitta override; the current timing/provenance interpretation remains live.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Apply future factual corrections through live guidance/catalog paths while preserving immutable historical source projections.

app_audit.finding: Generic manual wedge inherits manual gravity 1:16, 93-96 C, 150-210 s, equipment configuration capacity and 2.0 g/g water-retention output estimate.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Treat temperature and ratio as starting choices; do not make the shared time window a hardware deadline or retention coefficient a promised yield. Revalidate actual model and batch.

app_audit.finding: Historic audit says Voltage pulse schedule and 3:30-4:00 match without recording the source's contradictory step-duration arithmetic or 30/40 s bloom prose.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Append a dated follow-up distinguishing correct quantities from ambiguous timing; do not retrospectively alter historical provenance or claim the source changed without archived comparison.

uncertainties: Baseline 20/320, 94 C, 40/140/140 additions and 30 s first-contact bloom are app-authored starting choices and have not been physically brewed.
No verified universal maximum slurry capacity, outlet diameter or finish time; liquid headroom must be observed.
Current Voltage recipe duration sum is 215 s but prose says 210 s and card says 240 s; separate prose says 30 s bloom while instructions say 40 s.
No archived same-page comparison establishes whether Voltage changed since the historical audit.
US and European filter compatibility must follow the exact brewer label; Japanese regional numeric paper sizes are not automatically equivalent.
Beverage yield depends on coffee retention and drainage and is not measured here.
No device execution, localization review or kitchen test was performed.
do_not_claim: All Melitta drippers have one small outlet or all are interchangeable with V60.
#4 paper safely increases a smaller dripper's supported liquid capacity.
Voltage's current timing is one unambiguous exact 3:30-4:00 recipe.
Bloom performs no extraction, guarantees foaming or makes every coffee perfect.
Fines universally pass through intact paper and clog the dripper hole.
A fixed 2 g/g retention or 30-second decaf shortcut applies to every wedge brew.
320 g input water equals 320 ml by definition or a 320 g beverage.
This draft establishes physical-brew validation or release readiness.
